Q1.question: Is HYCOM-GLORYS field disagreement small or large relative to their trajectory separation?
Q1.label: COMPARABLE_ORDER
Q1.rule: per window: implied 72 h displacement of the A median vector difference (median|delta| x 259200 s) divided by the STEP 25C per-window median GLORYS-HYCOM 72 h separation; COMPARABLE_ORDER if ratio in [1/3, 3], FIELD_SMALLER if < 1/3, FIELD_LARGER if > 3; overall label = class reached by >= 3 of 4 windows, else MIXED

Q2_Q3.question: Does HYCOM or GLORYS look more similar to the AVISO surface-geostrophic structure under the tested metric?
Q2_Q3.label: GLORYS descriptively closer to the AVISO surface-geostrophic reference under the tested field metric
Q2_Q3.rule: per window with both B and C: closer = lower median vector difference to AVISO; GLORYS/HYCOM descriptively closer if >= 3 of 4 windows agree; otherwise no clear field-level difference; AVISO is a reference field, not ground truth
Q2_Q3.caveat: AVISO is a surface geostrophic reference field, not ground truth

Q4.question: Are differences concentrated in magnitude, direction or spatial pattern?
Q4.label: DIRECTION
Q4.rule: per window (comparison A): MAGNITUDE if |median relative speed difference| >= 0.25, DIRECTION if median absolute direction difference >= 30 degrees, MAGNITUDE_AND_DIRECTION if both, SPATIAL_STRUCTURE if neither and Pearson r(u) or r(v) < 0.5, else NONE_DOMINANT; overall = class reached by >= 3 of 4 windows, else MIXED

Q4_consistency.question: Do KE windows show consistent patterns?
Q4_consistency.label: MIXED

Q5.question: Do different GLORYS depths materially alter field agreement with AVISO?
Q5.label: NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE_WITH_DEPTH
Q5.rule: per window: max |relative change| of the C median vector difference at D05/D10/D20 versus D15; MATERIAL if > 0.10 in >= 3 of 4 windows (KE-1, KE-2, KE-H1, KE-H3), else NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE_WITH_DEPTH; no ranking

Q6.question: Can the trajectory-level product difference plausibly be associated with field-level forcing differences?
Q6.label: MIXED
Q6.rule: rank concordance between the STEP 25C per-window trajectory separation and the A median vector difference over the windows with both (pairs concordant / (concordant + discordant)); RANK_CONSISTENT if >= 5/6, RANK_INCONSISTENT if <= 1/6, else MIXED; evidence at most PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNTESTED (n = 4)
